items.difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（6 行证明）、族的平坦拉回 = 相对类合成：定义纤维化 + 构造基变换相容（0H4T）+ 已收卡 flat-pullback-as-action 纤维等式，两承重件全具名；unwinding 一句为机械展开（软点注记收）。2 处引用具名（其一无 canonical tag 走无 tag 指针判例，span 指源 label 行 2448），无 omit，收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-flat-pullback-as-composition (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2884-2891

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Unwind the family-level definitions to the fibres, use the base-change compatibility of the construction [X/X/Y]_e to identify the fibre of the constructed class with the construction on the fibre, and then the fibrewise assertion is exactly the flat-pullback-as-action lemma (source lines 2893-2898)
